subject: [PATCH pynfs 3/6] server41tests: check delegated times that predate the server's WRITE

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test case to the server41tests suite in the pynfs codebase. The test checks for delegated times that predate the server's WRITE stamp, which can occur when a client stamps the file's mtime on write(2) and then flushes later. The test is similar to an existing test (DELEG28), but with the added condition of early-stamping the mtime before the WRITE reaches the server. This patch addresses a problem where stat-dirty files were seen in git t1092 due to this issue.
